standard_prerequisites.name: The two clauses of the definition of a coherent module: local generation by finitely many sections and local finite generation of the kernels of the induced maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked in the counted proof (source lines 1881-1892) as a pointer to the definition of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies both the statement that a subsheaf inherits and the finiteness input for the kernel of a map into a coherent sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: The finiteness of extensions of modules of finite type, and the criterion for a category to be a weak Serre subcategory
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1948 and 1979-1980) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter and to a result of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finite typeness of the middle term of a short exact sequence and the last assertion.

core_obligations: Subsheaves: the first assertion is immediate because the second clause of the definition of coherence holds for any subsheaf of a coherent sheaf (proof lines 1881-1882)

Kernels: for a map from a module of finite type to a coherent module the proof chooses local generators of the source, applies the definition to the induced map from a finite direct sum into the target, and exhibits the kernel as the image of the kernel of that map (proof lines 1885-1896)

Cokernels: after reducing to the case where the finitely many sections lift, the proof builds a commutative diagram comparing the two presentations and applies the snake lemma to see that the module of relations of the cokernel is of finite type (proof lines 1899-1940)

Extensions: for a short exact sequence with coherent outer terms the proof repeats the same pattern, obtaining the module of relations as the kernel of a map from a finite type module to a coherent module (proof lines 1942-1976)
Conclusion: the last assertion follows because the previous ones verify the criterion for a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 1978-1981)
proof_roadmap: (1) 由「凝聚层的子层自动满足凝聚定义的 (2)」立得。(2) 取 x 的邻域 U 使 F|_U 由 s_1,…,s_n 生成，则 ⊕O_U → G 的核 K 有限型（凝聚定义 (2)），而 Ker φ 是 K → ⊕O_U → F 的像，故有限型。
(3) 核由 (2)+(1)；余核：把截面局部提升后作两个展示的比较图，用蛇形引理得 Ker(Ψ̄) 是有限型。(4) 同样作蛇形引理，得关系模是「有限型模到凝聚模的映射」的核，由 (2) 有限型。(5) 由 (3)(4) 满足弱 Serre 子范畴的判据。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the stability properties of coherent modules: subsheaves of coherent modules are coherent, kernels of maps from finite type modules to coherent modules are of finite type, kernels and cokernels of maps of coherent modules are coherent, the same holds for two out of three terms of a short exact sequence, and the coherent modules form a weak Serre subcategory (author lemma at source lines 1857-1878, label lemma-coherent-abelian). The proof (source lines 1880-1982) unwinds the definition of coherence for the kernel statement, then proves the cokernel and extension statements by writing down presentations, comparing them by commutative diagrams of free modules and applying the snake lemma, and finally invokes the criterion for a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 1938-1981). The two snake-lemma diagrams are the content. H3.
